name: indodax-cli
description: Professional CLI and MCP server for the Indodax cryptocurrency exchange. Supports market data, private account management, spot trading, paper trading, and real-time WebSocket streams.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Indodax API Key. Required for private operations like account info and trading.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your Indodax API Secret. Required for signing private requests.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_WS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Custom WebSocket token for private streams.
